receipt.checks: ZIP CRC; all file hashes; frozen metadata/sample IDs; targets; paired seeds; config snapshots/shards; prediction/weight identities; trace aggregates; ddof=1 means/std/n; cohorts
receipt.limits: No delivered code executed, GPU recomputation, or proof of generation-time provenance. Noise maps are not archived.

protocol.global_test: two-within-factor repeated-measures ANOVA; effect-specific subject interaction error; GG-corrected F p-values always used; Holm over 12 tests per cohort
protocol.effect: partial eta squared=SS_effect/(SS_effect+SS_subject_x_effect); not generalized eta squared, not causal explained variance
protocol.uncertainty: class-stratified original-image bootstrap, same draws for every model/method/metric; marginal percentile 95% CIs, not simultaneous intervals; singleton classes contribute no within-class bootstrap variation
protocol.ci_sensitivity: also 10000 ordinary paired original-image bootstrap draws (bootstrap_resamples argument controls both); iid_image_ci95 allows class proportions to vary; neither interval includes model-training uncertainty
protocol.direct_contrast: [benefit(a)-benefit(b)] on model_u minus same gap on model_v; benefit=-AUC or +Spearman. Positive means relative advantage of a is larger on u; not a universal method win
protocol.followup_test: direct paired DID signed-rank tests (normal approximation) and sign sensitivity; each Holm over 180 quality contrasts per cohort; rank p-values do not test the mean represented by the bootstrap CI
protocol.assumptions: independent original images and adequate sampling; F/GG is an approximate univariate RM test, not a distribution-free test; GG corrects sphericity df, not nonnormality, selection bias or training uncertainty
protocol.scope: datasets separate; three fixed models/checkpoints; no dataset-factor test, complete three-factor ANOVA, recorded-time inference, new GPU run, or teacher acceptance
